Definition: verified/100 means complete specified Erlang-observable return/error/side-effect API contract on the supported valid Erlang term model, established by complete source branch/partition argument plus actual pinned-original comparisons. It does not mean identical dynamic PID bytes, VM internals, timing, resource capacity or speed.

States.verified: Bounded complete logical API contract source-reviewed with actualoriginal evidence; eligiblefor100 underdefinition.
States.pending_verification: Implemented or no known mismatch is insufficient; identified contract evidence gaps remain.
States.known_difference: Confirmed source/observed divergence or unsupported valid inputs; never eligible100.

ReviewedErlangMfas.Contract: Returns the calling Erlang process identifier. No argument/error branches at arity0; identity is relational within its runtime, not literal PID-number equality across runtimes.

OriginalComparedEvidence.Source: begin self() ! X=42,receive X -> X after 0 -> no end end

ExhaustivePartitionArgument: Single valid invocation domain: current ProcessContext; SDK directly returns context.Self, OTP directly returns BIF_P.common.id.
No inputs, mutation, allocation-dependent value conversion or type branch; normal dispatch and guard source reviewed.

ReviewedErlangMfas.Contract: Returns current local node atom, nonode@nohost while undistributed; concerns name query, not distribution connection implementation.
ExhaustivePartitionArgument: Single valid invocation domain: current runtime local identity snapshot. SDK NodeAtom is Term.A(LocalIdentity.Snapshot.Node); OTP returns this-dist-entry sysname.

No argument/error cases; atom result before/after node identity changes is source-defined. Native339 setup changes node via actual setnode and then uses node-dependent request identities; separate guard3096 binds those captures.

ReviewedErlangMfas.Contract: True exactly for Erlang map terms, false for every other supported Erlang term including native record.
ExhaustivePartitionArgument: Partition2 every other valid term class: false from single C# type test, including separate NativeRecordTerm. This is exhaustive source proof over supported term representation, not a finite sample extrapolation.
OTP same single map-tag predicate; no errors/options/state changes. Guard dispatch reaches same handler.

ReviewedErlangMfas.Contract: True for bitstrings whose bit length is byte-aligned (including empty), false otherwise.

SdkSource.Anchor: (c, a) => Boolean(a[0] is BitString b && b.IsBinary)

ExhaustivePartitionArgument: Partition1 BitString with BitLength%8==0, including0: true.
Partition2 BitString with residual1..7 bits: false.
Partition3 all non-BitString valid term classes: false. BitString is sealed and enforces a nonnegative consistent length. OTP tests bitstring tag plus TAIL_BITS(size)==0.
No data contents/endian/length variation changes the predicate; normal and guard dispatch share handler.

ReviewedErlangMfas.Contract: True for both byte-aligned binaries and partial bitstrings including empty, false for non-bitstrings.
ExhaustivePartitionArgument: Partition1 any sealed BitString, aligned orpartial, empty ornonempty: true.
Partition2 all other valid term classes: false. OTP same bitstring-tag predicate; no error/option/state branches. Guard dispatch reaches same handler.
